definition: The commitment depends on something not yet decided: a later study, assessment, review, recommendation, decision, agreement or financing; or it is stated as an option that may be taken rather than something that will be done.
The World Bank itself carries it out: its staff, its supervision or appraisal, or analytical work it does rather than finances.
The borrower's government, a ministry, a public agency or the project implementation unit carries it out, with or without consultants it hires.
A network operator, utility, service provider or other enterprise, public or private, carries it out as the owner or operator of the asset.
A contractor, supplier, consultant or bidder must carry it out under a contract, bidding document or specification the project issues.
